tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Como é o teu irmão mais novo?” (Put the verb in the right form.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue tile ser / estar is a choice: pick the verb that gives the meaning of the situation, and put it in the right form. Some adjectives change meaning: ser esperto (clever) and estar pronto (ready), ser aborrecido (boring) and estar aborrecido (annoyed), ser vivo (sharp) and estar vivo (alive). Events take ser for their place (A festa é em …), people and things take estar (… está em …).
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Ser: como é sempre. Estar: como está agora ou onde está.
